findings.desc: doc-code-drift: docs/guide.md link to authority-client-role.md has inconsistent display text vs href — display shows `docs/requirements/decisions/authority-client-role.md` (project-root-relative) but href is `requirements/decisions/authority-client-role.md` (file-relative from docs/). README.md uses consistent project-root-relative href for both. While the link resolves correctly, the display text disagrees with the href convention used everywhere else, which could confuse readers manually copying the path.
